verses.text: The story of Bel and the Dragon was in the 1611 King James Version removed from Daniel, where it usually appears as chapter 14, and put into the Apocrypha instead, titled: “The history of the destruction of Bel and the Dragon, cut off from the end of Daniel.” For the digitalized text of the 1611 KJV, I cut off the first verse from the chapter and relocated it to the end of the previous chapter as Daniel 13:65. The subsequent verses, therefore, are not numbered as they were in the original 1611 KJV: this verse was originally the 2nd verse of Bel and the Dragon, Daniel 14:2 the 3rd verse, Daniel 14:3 the 4th verse, etc.

The original text of the 1611 KJV has here for verse 42 what in other editions of the Bible is verse 41. For the digitalized text of the 1611 KJV, I have renumbered the verses of this chapter, and the gap here is now filled by Daniel 14:42 from the 1609 Douay Old Testament.
